subject.title: fix(gateway): avoid duplicate launchd restart bootstrap

question: Should `OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_DOMAIN` and `OPENCLAW_LAUNCHD_UID` become supported macOS gateway restart controls, or should restart target selection remain derived from canonical launchd state and existing runtime facts?
rationale: The implementation is plausible, but adding effective environment-based service-routing controls is a compatibility and operator-contract choice that source review cannot make safely.

options.title: Trim implicit overrides
options.body: Remove the two new effective environment inputs and retain loaded-domain probing based on canonical console and caller facts.

options.title: Adopt and document overrides
options.body: Keep the inputs as supported controls, document precedence and recovery behavior, and add focused compatibility coverage.

options.title: Defer the contract change
options.body: Pause this PR until the gateway owner confirms the intended long-term launchd targeting surface.

recommendation.title: Trim implicit overrides
recommendation.body: Remove the two new effective environment inputs and retain loaded-domain probing based on canonical console and caller facts.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history most directly spans the launchd lifecycle and gateway restart paths affected by the contract choice.
